links.comparator_used: Unstructured sequential information delivery without the scaffold (the same model receiving staged case information)
links.outcome: Retention of the correct diagnosis, final accuracy and Convergence Regression across staged clinical information; top-1 accuracy
links.effect: Unstructured: 90% access, 60% retained (30% access-stability gap). SIPS scaffold: 80% access, 80% final accuracy, 0% Convergence Regression. Top-1 accuracy fell from 60% to 40% with scaffolding.
links.tradeoff: Scaffolding reduced top-1 accuracy from 60% to 40% (Convergence Hesitancy Paradox). Retention and convergence appear to be distinct reasoning tasks.
links.quote: A structured scaffold, the Sequential Information Prioritization Scaffold (SIPS), eliminates this gap entirely through forced hypothesis accountability: 80% access, 80% final accuracy, 0% Convergence Regression.

design_hint: structured prompt scaffold enforcing hypothesis accountability
